state.paragraph: During the period from the middle of August through the end of October, the Company developed the Profit Improvement Plan and prepared for a sale process. During this period, J.P. Morgan was contacted by 27 potential participants in a sale process, including three strategic parties (not counting Industry Participant) and 24 financial participants (including potential lead buyers as well as large suppliers of equity capital to lead buyers).
state.target_sentence: During this period, J.P. Morgan was contacted by 27 potential participants in a sale process, including three strategic parties (not counting Industry Participant) and 24 financial participants (including potential lead buyers as well as large suppliers of equity capital to lead buyers).

criteria.row_5: 07/03/2014 | JANA Partners | Activist | 13D at 9.9%; sought review of alternatives including a sale. Further 13D amendments and public letters in July–August advocating a sale; met the Company 07/10/2014 advocating a sale.
criteria.row_6: 07/07/2014 | Longview | Activist | Shareholder; public letter urging board to consider a sale; would consider rolling some or all holdings into buyer equity. Met board in May without advocating; reiterated sale advocacy 07/10/2014.
criteria.row_8: 08/07/2014 | Industry Participant | Bidder interest | Privately-held industry competitor; contacted J.P. Morgan after rumours, may revisit spring 2014 talks (PetSmart-initiated merger/acquisition discussions, which IP rebuffed citing antitrust). No price.
criteria.row_9: 08/13/2014 | PetSmart board | Target sale decision | Board decided to explore alternatives incl. a sale, with Profit Improvement Plan as standalone fallback; ad hoc committee to oversee; J.P. Morgan outreach deferred to late Sept/early Oct; public announcement planned.
criteria.row_10: mid-August – 10/03/2014 | 24 financial participants | Contact | Parties contacted J.P. Morgan (inbound); includes potential lead buyers and large equity suppliers. All 27 reported to board by 10/03. Reasons section: Company “contacted or were contacted by more than 25”.
criteria.row_11: mid-August – 10/03/2014 | 3 strategic parties | Contact | Inbound contacts to J.P. Morgan, excluding Industry Participant. None signed a confidentiality agreement (all 15 signers were financial).
criteria.row_12: 08/19/2014 | PetSmart | Sale process announced | Press release with Q2 earnings; intended to let parties not contacted approach J.P. Morgan on their own initiative.
criteria.row_13: 08/27/2014 | Industry Participant | Other material event | Target refused admission: on ad hoc committee direction, J.P. Morgan conveyed concerns (08/22), then said IP not invited (antitrust, information, delay risks); proposals would be considered. Reaffirmed 10/03. No later contact; never entered
criteria.row_14: first week of October 2014 | PetSmart / J.P. Morgan | Round opened | Round 1 opened by the NDA wave (buyers came to target; no outreach wave reported). Board told 10/03 about 15 parties interested.
criteria.row_15: first week of October 2014 | 15 financial NDA signers | NDA signed | Confidentiality and standstill agreements. All 15 did diligence in October, had senior-management presentations and detailed business-plan and Profit Improvement Plan information. Includes Buyer Group, Bidder 2 and all IOI submitters.
criteria.row_16: during October 2014 | PetSmart / J.P. Morgan | Deadline set | Non-binding preliminary IOIs due 10/30. Bidders told Longview would roll over up to 7.5 million shares if bidder wished; asked to indicate interest, not a condition.
criteria.row_17: 10/30/2014 | Buyer Group | Bid | price 81-83 | Preliminary non-binding IOI; range. Consortium led by BC Partners funds (later with CDPQ, GIC, StepStone). Terms beyond price not reported.
criteria.row_18: 10/30/2014 | Unnamed financial bidder 1 | Bid | price 80-85 | Preliminary non-binding IOI; range. Advanced 11/03; on recommended reading, later part of Bidder 3.
criteria.row_19: 10/30/2014 | Unnamed financial bidder 2 | Bid | Third of three IOIs whose range “reached at least $80.00”; endpoints not disclosed, so price cells blank. Advanced 11/03; on recommended reading, later part of Bidder 3.
criteria.row_20: 10/30/2014 | Bidder 2 | Bid | price 78 | Preliminary non-binding IOI at a point price.
criteria.row_21: 10/30/2014 | 2 other IOI submitters | Bid | Six IOIs in total; the remaining two, prices undisclosed but below the $80.00 cut-off (inferred from the board’s advancement rule). Reasons section says IOIs came from 5 bidder groups.
criteria.row_22: 10/30/2014 | PetSmart | Deadline | Due date for non-binding preliminary indications of interest.
criteria.row_23: by 10/30/2014 | 9 NDA signers without IOI | Did not submit | 15 signers − 6 submitters = 9. J.P. Morgan heard their rationales for not submitting (10/30–11/02); rationales not disclosed. Would be 10 if only 5 IOIs (Q4).
criteria.row_24: 10/30–11/02/2014 | Bidder 2 | Bid | price 81-84 | Revises #19 after J.P. Morgan calls on rationales for price levels; raised $78.00 to a range, bringing it above the $80.00 cut-off.
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
